evals.prompt: írj egy ADR-t arról, hogy a mobil BLE réteg most már kezeli a külön write/notify karakterisztikás nyomtatókat (Phomemo, Marklife)
evals.expected_output: Finds the next free number (0045 at the time of writing), writes docs/adr/0045-<slug>.md from 0000-template.md with Status proposed and today's date, bold-led Decision bullets naming Gatt.kt, Gatt.swift and gatt.rs, Consequences stating what did not run on a phone and the schema impact, appends the README index row, and adds an Update note to ADR-0037 plus the roadmap Later item change.

evals.prompt: Phase 7 is done, write the close-out ADR.
evals.expected_output: Follows the ADR-0034/0040 close-out pattern: performs a real exit audit of the phase's ADRs against the code before writing, lists hardware checks not run, faults fixed, tests, docs, left-as-is and deferred items with reasons; adds the README row, a phase exit-status table in feature-matrix.md and roadmap updates.

evals.prompt: We decided to drop the TCP default port 9100 in favour of requiring an explicit port. Record that decision.
evals.expected_output: Writes a new proposed ADR with context on ADR-0037's 9100 default, decision and consequences; does not edit ADR-0037's decision text but adds a pointer or marks it partially changed; indexes it in docs/adr/README.md and links it from docs/protocol-languages.md §7.1 and docs/agents/tools.md where the default is documented.
